test.name: Simple place lookup — Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania
test.description: Basic Wikipedia lookup for a genealogically relevant place. The simplest happy path — no apostrophes or parentheses, clear Wikipedia article exists. Tests the core workflow: call wikipedia_search, fill the template, and log it as one research-log entry with the template in notes.

input.delegation:
Look up Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania on Wikipedia

topic: Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should call `wikipedia_search` with a query targeting the place (the exact form like 'Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania' or 'Schuylkill County' matters less than that it would retrieve the intended article)
The logged entry's notes should follow the template (article title as H1, the full extract, the source URL) — no fabricated content beyond what the tool returned

The summary is logged as one research-log entry (tool wikipedia_search) and appears in the file changes summary as a new `log` entry; its `notes` hold the filled template. Grade the entry from that diff. Its byte-for-byte match to the tool response is checked by test_log_notes_match_template, not by you.
